prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A Note App That Keeps Up With Your Thoughts
plan.description: A quick launch video for a new note-taking app that helps you capture ideas the moment they appear. Write it down, find it later, and never lose a good thought again.

beats.narration: You had a great idea this morning. Now it's gone. Sound familiar? Your brain is for thinking, not for remembering everything.
Meet our new note-taking app. Open it and get your thoughts down quickly.
Search helps you find your notes when you need them. Capture it now, find it later. Start taking notes today.

warnings: length: the narration totals 65 words in 3 beats but a 30-second video needs about 58 (between 52 and 58). Cut about 7 words: 3 to 4 beats of about 19 words each (you averaged 21; count the words of every beat), one idea, no preamble and no recap; keep the hook and the last line
grounding: 2 beats had unsupported specifics, 2 rewritten
